_note: Inline percentile-as-threshold: revenue from top-decile customers by
lifetime spend. The two-round-trip pattern (compute P90 → filter on
P90) collapses to a single query. The threshold is materialised in
a CTE next to the predicate source and CROSS JOIN'd into the set
CTE, so the WHERE clause reads `__predicate_value >= __threshold`
Inline threshold shape (validated at parse time):
The optional `measure` key must match the predicate's input measure;
cross-measure thresholds remain a two-step pattern for now.
Note: this example aggregates revenue without a group_by because
combining a customer-grain percentile predicate with a store-grain
cross-grain constraint that lives in the compiler. Add the group_by
